inputs.text: Style: photorealistic restrained cinematic realism. The father remains seated on the front edge of the blue chair with both elbows on his knees and his hands tightly clasped. With extremely small amplitude and slow speed, he gradually raises only his eyes and chin toward the distant red emergency light and completes one restrained deep breath; his chest and shoulders rise only slightly. He then holds his gaze on the red light while keeping his hands clasped. His five-year-old daughter remains almost completely still beside him. Her right shoelace remains visibly untied and her left shoelace remains tied. Their faces, clothing, body proportions, chairs and cool hospital architecture remain unchanged. The locked camera remains completely static with no pan, tilt, zoom or shake. A faint fluorescent electrical hum and distant hospital trolley sound are heard. No speech.
